How to set up an Apple MagSafe Charger
Shop

Apple's MagSafe Charger doesn't require Bluetooth pairing, an app, or special configuration. Just connect it to power and attach it magnetically to your compatible iPhone.

Connect the charger: Plug the MagSafe Charger's USB-C cable into a compatible USB-C power adapter.

Plug into an outlet: Connect the adapter to a wall socket.

Position your iPhone: Place the back of your iPhone against the MagSafe Charger, with the magnetic charging surface facing the phone.

Check charging: A charging animation should appear on your iPhone screen, and the battery icon should indicate charging.

For best results, use a MagSafe-compatible case or remove a thick or noncompatible case.

Which power adapter should you use?
